local-zones.diagramCaption: A Local Zone is an extension of a parent Region: you add a Local Zone subnet to your VPC and run latency-sensitive tiers close to metro users.

wavelength.diagram:

wavelength.diagramCaption: Wavelength puts compute inside the 5G carrier network so mobile traffic reaches your app without leaving the carrier; the rest of the app stays in the Region.

app-runner.diagramCaption: App Runner is closed to new customers: redeploy the same image with ECS Express Mode and shift traffic with Route 53 weighted records.

ecs.diagramCaption: An ECS service keeps N tasks running behind a load balancer on Fargate or EC2 capacity; the execution role pulls images/secrets and the task role is the app identity.

fargate.diagram:
flowchart TD ecs@svc(ecs, "ECS service") --> t1 eks@svc(eks, "EKS pods") --> t2 subgraph VPC[VPC private subnets] t1@svc(fargate, "Task

fargate.diagramCaption: Fargate runs each ECS task or EKS pod in its own isolated micro-VM with its own ENI; you size vCPU/memory and never manage instances.

ecr.diagram:

ecr.diagramCaption: ECR is the private image registry in the build→scan→replicate→deploy chain; Inspector scans images and replication feeds multi-Region deploys.

s3-glacier.diagramCaption: Use the S3 Glacier storage classes via lifecycle rules, not the legacy vault API (closed to new customers); retrieval speed and cost fall as you go colder.

ebs.diagram:
flowchart TD subgraph AZA[AZ a] ec2@svc(ec2) v@svc(ebs, "gp3 / io2 volume") end ec2 --- v v -->|snapshot| snap@svc(s3, "Snapshots

ebs.diagramCaption: An EBS volume lives in one AZ; snapshots stored regionally are how you move, restore or DR a volume into another AZ, Region or account.

efs.diagram:

storage-gateway.diagramCaption: Storage Gateway gives on-prem apps familiar protocols (NFS/SMB, iSCSI, VTL) with a local cache while the data lands in S3, EBS snapshots or Glacier.

aurora.diagramCaption: Aurora writer and up to 15 readers share one six-copy volume across 3 AZs; Global Database adds cross-Region replicas with ~1 s lag and fast promotion.

per partition"]:::note
dynamodb.diagramCaption: The partition key hashes items onto partitions with fixed per-partition throughput, so choose a high-cardinality key; Streams feed Lambda for change-driven work.

  app@svc(ecs, "App") -->|1 GET key| c

vs ElastiCache async replication"]:::note -.- log

  u[Users]:::user --> cf@svc(cloudfront, "Edge cache")
